verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own docs name a no-code Workflow Builder and call-handling features, including State-based Rules and Interaction Rules, which are event-triggered rules. Event notifications and subscriptions provide the event backbone, though as developer building blocks they add little credit on their own. The evidence is only navigation-level titles, so the depth of the rule engine, the range of triggers and actions, and support for general events beyond call routing are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Workflow Builder triggers/conditions/actions, evidence that rules extend beyond call routing to general events, hands-on or independent corroboration.
